payload.title: Epic 0 — Product identity and clean baseline
Rename the LUTzy fork to Lumo across package and app surfaces
Preserve upstream attribution and rewrite product documentation for Lumo
Establish the post-rename build and regression baseline
Epic 1 — Durable per-photo edit domain
Version the durable edit schema and rendering pipeline identity
Isolate edit state per photo during navigation
Persist per-photo edit records with atomic recovery
Implement per-photo undo and redo with gesture grouping
Copy and paste edits to one or many photos
Epic 2 — Render orchestration, caching, and observability
Expand rendering into explicit request, result, and quality tiers
Coalesce interactive renders and settle to final preview quality
Add bounded thumbnail, developed-source, and preview caches
Schedule visible, adjacent, grid, and background image work by priority
Instrument the end-to-end image workflow with signposts and metrics
Epic 3 — Folder library and rapid culling
Introduce stable PhotoAsset and library metadata records
Build progressive cancellable folder ingestion and metadata loading
Create a prioritized thumbnail service using embedded previews when useful
Build a virtualized library grid with multi-selection
Implement rating, pick/reject, filters, and keyboard culling
Epic 4 — Photographic Light controls
Define the Light adjustment model, ranges, order, and migration
Refine Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, and Shadows behavior
Implement Whites and Blacks endpoint controls
Implement a versioned RGB tone curve model and renderer
Ship the Light inspector with reset and interaction semantics
Epic 5 — White balance, mixer, and color grading
Implement As Shot and RAW-aware white balance behavior
Harden Vibrance and Saturation as distinct global color controls
Implement the eight-channel HSL Color Mixer
Implement three-way Color Grading with blending and balance
Ship responsive Color, Mixer, and Grading inspector sections
Epic 6 — Photographic effects
Implement distinct Texture, Clarity, and Dehaze stages
Implement advanced post-crop vignette
Implement deterministic resolution-aware photographic grain
Ship Effects inspector sections and quality gate
Epic 7 — LUTs as an optional Look stage
Harden optional LUT identity and resolution across persisted edits
Reframe the LUT library as a Look inspector
Verify LUT behavior through persistence, copy/paste, and full export
Epic 8 — Image-centric editor experience
Build the Library/Edit navigation shell and image-centric layout
Implement zoom, pan, fit, and fill on the editor canvas
Unify before/after comparison for every edit stage
Coalesce histogram updates from the displayed render
Complete filmstrip navigation, focus-safe shortcuts, resets, and accessibility
Epic 9 — Reliable full-resolution export
Define durable export options and format capabilities
Export current or selected photos from originals and saved edits
Add batch progress, cancellation, collision handling, and failure isolation
Add optional Apple Photos delivery after file export is stable
Epic 10 — Image quality, performance, and MVP release gate
Create the curated image-quality validation matrix and rubric
Build repeatable large-library and render benchmark scenarios
Profile and fix the highest-impact measured bottlenecks
Run fault-recovery and end-to-end MVP release acceptance
